record: full run of the blocks in docs/verifying-npm-packages.md, every attested version plus the controls
invocation: bash scripts/verify-npm-packages-doc.sh docs/verifying-npm-packages.md <out> all (SHELL_UNDER_TEST=zsh for the zsh run)

cellKey.G1: latest version, block as written: exit 0, last line Verified OK
cellKey.G2: every published version from the first attested one, version variable set: exit 0, last line Verified OK
cellKey.T: one byte appended to the packed tarball by an npm shim: non-zero with the digest error
cellKey.I: identity changed by one token (the repository): non-zero with the identity error
cellKey.C: another genuine tarball and bundle served under the requested name: non-zero with the tarball check message
cellKey.V: an injected version string (regexp block only): non-zero with the version check message
cellKey.U: a version from before provenance began: non-zero with the curl error; cosign never runs

ciRunNote: local run on macOS; the CI workflow records Linux bash and macOS zsh runs once it lands
